messages:
maya: quick ux check — compact composer streaming behavior. thinking of a ‘hush’ intermediate state when stream is active where the primary CTA becomes a single stop affordance, regenerate is visually de-emphasized/disabled until stream ends. also token counter placement feels noisy on the right; suggestions? :thinking: derek: +1 to a single primary stop. question: is it Pause (can resume) or Stop (final)? semantics matter for copy + shortcut. my vote: Stop = final, Pause = rare, we should default to Stop. :eyes: sam: agree with derek. keyboard mapping: `Esc` to stop, `Shift+Esc` to cancel+clear? also event names: `playground.stream_stop` vs `playground.stream_pause`. keep analytics consistent. ana: accessibility nits: token counter updates need `aria-live=\"polite\"` and `aria-atomic=\"true\"` so SRs get incremental counts without noise. tooltip for stop must be explicit: \"Stop streaming output\" not just \"Stop\". also ensure focus stays on composer controls after stopping. :a11y: jessie: microcopy suggestion: primary button tooltip -> \"Stop response (Esc)\". disabled regenerate state microcopy -> \"Regenerate after stopping\". token counter compact copy -> just \"Tokens: 1,234\" with SR-only additional context like \"Response token count, updates live\". maya: prompt library quick-insert collides with token counter when composer width shrinks. options: move token counter left of send button, or collapse into overflow menu. UX preference? derek: move left of send button. keeps visual grouping of send-state + tokens. if width < 420px, collapse to just an icon with accessible label. sam: dev note — streaming fallback: if network hiccup we currently show a spinner + snackbar. propose showing small inline status: \"Streaming paused — retry?\" with retry button that resumes KV-cache aware stream. also regenerate should respect pinned prompt context. maya: small code example for aria live we can give engs: ```html
Tokens: 123
``` ana: also flag: announce when regenerate becomes available (SR) e.g., `aria-live=\"assertive\"` for the change from disabled->enabled, but be careful not to spam. recommend a role=status region that announces once per state change. aria-bot: accessibility lint results (quick): recommends role/status wrapper, ensure `aria-hidden` on visual-only counter for SR fallback, verify color contrast for disabled regenerate (AA pass). links: https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-live jessie: visual idea: when streaming, reduce opacity of regenerate to 50% and show a subtle pill label "streaming" next to token meter. makes state obvious w/o extra copy. :zap: maya: action items: 1) design to mock two variants (left token vs collapsed) — @jessie 2) eng to add `aria-live` + update shortcuts/events — @sam 3) accessibility to run SR pass on both variants — @ana 4) finalize microcopy strings and tooltips — @derek. I'll drop mocks by EOD Fri. derek: sounds good. I'll draft analytics events + a short QA checklist for release. sam: will prototype a small sample of stream resume behavior in `playground-ui` branch and link PR. ana: will run TalkBack/VoiceOver checks when mocks land. maya: thanks all — feel free to drop quick screenshots here when ready. :thumbsup:
